Name: Seasonal Hedge Fences
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
You can leaf the other fence designs alone. Seasonal Hedge Fences introduces six hedge styles to pick from, inspired by popular recolors:
[list]
[*]Vanilla[[/*]
[*]Starblue Valley[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4436]Ashajin[/url][/*]
[*]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolor[/*]
[*]Naturally Valley[/*]
[*]Kookiefroggie Recolor[/*]
[/list]These hedges are seasonal, with an all new gate that will match the tone of each recolor as well!

[url=https://imgur.com/a/3PNkyPL]Referenced with permission[/url] and so grateful Ashajin let me keep their style of hedge accessible for everyone! Hedge art has been redrawn and gates are wholly original.

[b][size=3]✧ Alternative Textures ✧ [/size][/b]
The  Seasonal Hedge Fence [AT] pack lets you paint fences in-world. Use the Paint Bucket tool (sold by Robin) on wood, stone, iron, or hardwood fences to choose any of the six hedge styles and seasonal looks. Mix and match by segment—great for variety along long fence lines.

[b][size=3]✧ Content Patcher ✧ [/size][/b]
The Seasonal Hedge Fence [CP] pack applies hedges by configuration. Enable or disable seasonal hedges for each fence type (wood, stone, iron, hardwood), set season (current in-game or a fixed season), and style. Edit the config.json created after first run, or use Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended).
